text: Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Tom. Tom lived near the beach and liked to play every day. One morning, Tom found a little boat under a tree. Tom felt sad and wanted to show it to Mia. Mia said, "Wow, that is a nice little boat! Can we play with it together?" They played until the sun went down. At the end of the day, Tom was sad, because sharing is fun.
